experiment: Standalone Qwen3-Omni Talker / MTP VRAM Fit

measurements.failure_cause: CUDA memory fragmentation under Windows WDDM allocator; expandable_segments is unsupported on Windows

reasons: Talker contains 3.32B parameters across 20 layers of 128 MoE experts, requiring ~6.65 GB pure tensor storage.
On Windows, system GUI processes (Desktop Window Manager, Edge, Explorer, Armoury Crate) hold ~2.1 GB of locked VRAM.
PyTorch CUDA allocator on Windows WDDM experiences block fragmentation when allocating 192 MB expert weight blocks across 20 layers, triggering OOM at layer 16 (9.96 GB PyTorch allocation).
Training with AdamW optimizer states and forward activations would require at least 18-22 GB of VRAM in BF16, definitively exceeding a 16 GB gaming card.
scientific_verdict.solution_for_future: Offload Thinker features on the 256 GB M5 Ultra, and for Talker training on RTX 5080, use 4-bit NF4 quantized base weights with QLoRA, or execute the full Talker training on the M5 Ultra.

mtp_lora_dry_run.experiment: Standalone MTP LoRA One-Step Dry Run
mtp_lora_dry_run.scientific_conclusion: The multi-token speech predictor (MTP) component trains with extreme efficiency on RTX 5080 (under 0.8 GB peak VRAM). For the 3.3B MoE Talker backbone, 4-bit QLoRA or M5 Ultra host offloading provides the required memory headroom.
